_note: This file is the single source of truth for the Phase 3 Real-Data Replication protocol (Phase 3.1-RD), companion to docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_PROTOCOL.md. It was written and committed BEFORE any real-data evaluation was run. Do not edit values in this file to chase a better-looking result. This file does NOT modify, inherit values into, or override configs/phase3_1_protocol.json, configs/phase3_5_attack_protocol.json, or configs/phase3_6_decision_recovery_protocol.json -- those remain frozen artifacts of the original synthetic-data Phase 3.

relationship_to_original_phase3.original_phase3_status: FROZEN, read-only, not modified by this protocol
relationship_to_original_phase3._note: This results directory does not exist yet. It is created only when Phase 3.1-RD is executed under separate authorization -- see execution_gate below.

execution_gate._note: DO NOT RUN. This protocol is frozen for design purposes only. Explicit separate authorization is required before any evaluation script under this protocol executes.

alibaba_gpu2020.eligible_population_definition: terminal jobs only, status in {Terminated, Failed}; Running/Waiting excluded as right-censored, never imputed
alibaba_gpu2020._tier_used_note: Robustness tier (50000) is reserved for a future robustness check, not part of Phase 3.1-RD. Main tier is not swapped for a different tier after seeing results.
alibaba_gpu2020._machine_count_note: Machine-level generalization claims are bounded by this count, not by job or row count.

aiops_2020._status_note: Explicit for every hypothesis regardless of point estimate or p-value. See power_analysis below.

agentrx_magentic.origin: benchmark-harness evaluation environment, not organic production traffic, not fault-injected either

agentrx_tau_retail.origin: benchmark-harness evaluation environment, not organic production traffic, not fault-injected either

datasets._pooling_rule: These four datasets are never pooled into a single joint experiment. AgentRx Magentic and tau-Retail are kept as two separate domains, never merged to reach n=73.

hypothesis_dataset_mapping._H7_note: No dataset currently held records a recovery action/outcome. This is reported as a structural limitation, never approximated or inferred.

alibaba_sampling._note: Reused verbatim from data/audit/alibaba_gpu2020/. Not re-sampled by this protocol.
alibaba_sampling.selection_method: lexicographic sort of job_name, then random.Random(seed).sample

alibaba_leakage_exclusions._exclusion_reason: Official documentation confirms these are full-instance-lifetime aggregates/maxima computed over the span of the instance whose outcome is being predicted -- post-outcome leakage.
alibaba_leakage_exclusions._consequence_note: Alibaba real-data representation/failure-prediction experiments are necessarily based on request/scheduling-time information, not runtime telemetry. This is stated explicitly in every H1/H2 write-up on this dataset.

temporal._shift_note: Confirmed real distribution shift discovered before evaluation. Reported alongside every metric on this split, never corrected by rebalancing or reweighting.

machine_disjoint_split._reason: job-to-machine relationship is many-to-many; not solved by this protocol. Documented as a limitation, not silently skipped.

aiops_window_protocol._note: Reused verbatim from docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_AIOPS_PROTOCOL.md. Not altered after seeing evaluation results.
aiops_window_protocol.prediction_vs_diagnosis_rule: PRE-FAILURE window only for predictive features; DURING/POST usable only for diagnosis, never mixed into prediction

negative_window_construction.eligible_entities: same 43 fault-eligible entities as positive pool
negative_window_construction.selection_method: lexicographic sort by (date, block_start), then random.Random(seed).sample

known_unresolved_issues: block=8 spans two calendar dates (2020-05-29 and 2020-05-30), unexplained
+6-hour shift between log_time and start_time for log_block in {4,5} (11 of 70 index>=100 rows), cause not determined
whether fault-log index 1-11 were part of the scored evaluation or an unscored preview batch is uncertain
27 of 43 fault-eligible entities never appear in the fault log -- genuine normalcy vs unrelated exclusion reason is an open question
aiops_window_protocol._do_not_fix_note: These irregularities remain documented and are not silently corrected, imputed around, or excluded without being reported as a limitation.

agentrx_domains._pooling_rule: Never pooled to inflate N. Kept as two separate domains throughout.

statistics.aiops_bootstrap_unit: entity (cluster bootstrap over the 43 entities, not over windows)
statistics.cross_dataset_comparison: qualitative consistency check only (same-direction/different-direction, overlapping/non-overlapping CIs) -- never a single pooled statistical test across datasets
statistics._p_value_rule: P-values, where computed, are always reported alongside effect size and confidence interval, never alone.

alibaba_main_tier.method: Hanley-McNeil (1982) approximate AUROC variance at observed 25.94% base rate

agentrx.conclusion: exploratory, wide CIs expected, no stable-AUROC threshold met

power_analysis._timing_note: All power analyses were performed before sampling (Alibaba) and before window extraction (AIOps), per docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_CLEANING_REPORT.md section 15 and docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_AIOPS_PREPARATION_COMPLETE.md section 6. No tier or window count is changed after seeing evaluation results.

split_rules.test_set_touch_policy: touched exactly once, for final evaluation, after all modeling decisions are frozen
split_rules.validation_use_policy: legitimate model-selection/tuning only, per this protocol
split_rules.aiops_validation: no separate validation carved from 226 windows; model-selection choices reused from Alibaba validation or fixed a priori from original Phase 3 candidate definitions (src/evaluation/representations.py), never tuned on AIOps data
split_rules.agentrx_validation: no separate validation carved from 44 or 29 trajectories; same reuse rule as AIOps

reproducibility.raw_data_policy: no file under data/raw/ is modified by any Phase 3.1-RD script

prohibited_actions: selecting or dropping a dataset after seeing its evaluation result
rebalancing a test set after evaluation
altering AIOps window definitions after evaluation
selecting representation/model based on test performance
treating missing information as negative evidence
inflating sample size via correlated child rows/windows
modifying original Phase 3 frozen results, configs, scripts, or reports

comparison_with_original_phase3.output_document: docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_COMPARISON.md (created only when comparison is produced; does not overwrite docs/PHASE3_4_COMPARISON.md)
comparison_with_original_phase3._disagreement_rule: Disagreement between original and real-data results is not automatically treated as evidence the original result was wrong; both are reported with reasons divergence might occur (feature availability, domain, N, leakage constraints).

_unified_benchmark_note: No common schema is forced across datasets at this stage. A field is only populated where it genuinely exists in the source data; never fabricated. See docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_PROTOCOL.md section 25.
